diagnosis: The Prisma middleware omits companyId checks during update operations on FleetVehicle because Prisma's update API requires a unique where input. As a consequence, the route updates any vehicle record matching req.params.vin without verifying that the vehicle belongs to req.user.companyId. An attacker can reassign or decommission competitor fleet vehicles.
